svg.title: Toolbox
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, C#, Python, Dart, C. Web: Next.js, React, Angular, Tailwind, Three.js. Mobile: Flutter, React Native. Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Spring Boot, .NET, FastAPI, Prisma, Supabase. Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, MySQL. AI and ML: PyTorch, Claude API, LangGraph, MediaPipe, ONNX Runtime. Ship: Vercel, Cloudflare, Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux, Figma.
